name: LEAF
description:
About This Game

This is a 2.5D top-down roguelike shooter crafted with boundless passion by a team of young creators in their early twenties, marking their debut game project. Driven by our love for indie games, we’ve polished every combat detail to perfection and kept refining the gameplay based on player feedback—all to deliver an unadulterated, addictive single-player adventure experience. No clunky social features, no tedious queue times for team-ups; just grab your gun, fight your way north, break through wave after wave of obstacles, and set your sights on the ultimate target: the Iron Bulwark.

Venture North—No Two Runs Are the Same

At the core of the gameplay lies the "Northern Expedition" journey. Every step from your starting outpost to the Iron Bulwark brims with the thrill of the unknown. Randomly generated enemy placements, loot spawns, and level layouts guarantee fresh surprises with every restart. Death is not the end—gather growth resources to unlock permanent talents, making each subsequent run smoother and bringing you one step closer to the Iron Bulwark’s closely guarded secrets. Immerse yourself in a fully single-player experience, focus on pure combat and strategy, and savor an undisturbed adventure pace.

A Robust Arsenal System—Build Your Devastating Loadout

The game features 32 distinct firearms, ranging from high-speed submachine guns to heavy sniper cannons. Each weapon comes with its own unique skill and item, letting you unleash one-of-a-kind firepower right from the get-go. Pair these with 32 weapon attachments and 8 functional drones, and you’ll unlock hundreds of combat builds to suit your playstyle. Will you deploy a drone for constant cover fire, equip armor-piercing rounds for pinpoint single-target takedowns? Or opt for a rapid-fire gun with extended magazines, paired with an area-damage drone to mow down hordes of enemies? The choice is entirely yours.

Diverse Skill Combinations—Max Out Your Combat Potential

Beyond weapons and drones, 8 attribute enhancements and 18 throwable skills add even more depth to your tactical options. Attribute boosts let you target core stats like damage, fire rate, and health, while throwables cover everything from area-of-effect blasts and slowing traps to lingering damage zones. These mechanics complement your weapon loadout flawlessly, infusing every battle with strategic fun through endless combinations.

Minimalist Artistic Cutscenes—Elevate Immersion

Each new area triggers a unique minimalist cutscene. Free of verbose dialogue, these sequences use delicate visual storytelling and atmospheric cues to set the context for your journey’s progression. They never interrupt your adventure flow, yet they lend a sense of ceremony to your northbound quest. The 2.5D top-down perspective and crisp combat interface ensure that even the most intense bullet-hell encounters remain clear and manageable, letting you focus on precise shooting while soaking in the unique charm of each environment transition.

A Passion Project—Evolving Nonstop

As our team’s first game, we’ve approached development with unwavering sincerity—tweaking weapon feel, balancing the talent system, and polishing cutscenes, every update is a testament to our pursuit of quality. We know the game still has room to grow, and we’ll keep listening to player feedback to iterate and expand content. Our goal is to turn this passion-fueled roguelike shooter into your go-to stress-reliever for those quick, satisfying gaming sessions.

No Internet Required—Play Anytime, Anywhere!

Grab your custom weapon loadout, charge northward to break through obstacles, and embrace the addictive thrill of "just one more run" as randomness and strategy collide. Launch your ultimate assault on the Iron Bulwark now!

If you love our game, feel free to point out its shortcomings—we’re all ears!

short_desc: LEAF is a 2.5D top-down roguelike shooter. Waking up from a 200-year sleep, you follow “Destiny” north. Fight through nations and wastelands using guns, talents and mechanical drones to reach the Iron Bulwark, liberate the oppressed, and earn one final chance to see your child again.
